description: This file defines diagnostics related to the usage of [GenerateSerializer] in reference assemblies within the Orleans code generation project. It includes constants describing the diagnostic ID, title, message format, description, category, and a method to create diagnostic instances when certain serialization issues are detected.

classes.name: ReferenceAssemblyWithGenerateSerializerDiagnostic
classes.description: A static class containing diagnostic definitions and a factory method for reporting issues related to [GenerateSerializer] usage in reference assemblies.

methods.name: CreateDiagnostic
methods.description: Creates and returns a Diagnostic object for a given symbol, indicating a serialization warning or error.
